description: START HERE to plan golf near a place, transit station, address, or US ZIP: pass the place text as location, plus access (public/private/all) and holes (9/18) if known. Coordinates are optional; no slug knowledge is needed. Resolves the location and returns its labeled center and a nearest-first ranked shortlist with canonical Stymie URLs, reusable slugs, straight-line miles, access, holes, and scorecard availability. If the place is ambiguous, ask the golfer to choose a candidate. NEXT call build_golf_trip with the returned latitude/longitude and the same preferences for 1-4 course picks. Use search_courses only for a specific course name. Copy returned URLs verbatim; distances are not drive/transit times.

country.description: Country code to disambiguate a place; GB means UK

distance_miles.description: Search radius in miles: one of 5, 10, 20, 25, 50

holes.description: Total course holes; omit if flexible

location.description: Place name, transit station, address, or US ZIP; extract the place from the golfer’s sentence

state.description: State/province code, e.g. IL, ON, or NSW, to disambiguate a place

name: find_nearby_courses
title: Find Nearby Courses
